name: Kuaizhou 11
location_str: Launch Area 95A @ Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: Launch Area 95A is up to 6 launches this year, and 69 since its first in 2015. The pad had 5 days to reset after the last one.
slot_b_text: Max-Q is the point during ascent when a rocket experiences its highest dynamic pressure, caused by the combination of air density and speed.
